name: jev-toolkit
description: Claude Code mods built on a judgement model (TypeSafe Jev).

plugins.name: jev-router
plugins.description: Asks a judgement model (TypeSafe Jev) how big each prompt is and picks the Claude model and effort for it.

plugins.name: jev-context
plugins.description: Advises when a big context is worth compacting or clearing, and searches a log of past sessions. Advice only; shares one judge request with jev-router when both are installed.
